zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機5架次與共艦5艘 3架共機進入西南及東部空域
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲共機5架次與共艦5艘；3架共機進入西南及東部空域；國軍派機艦飛彈監控。
body: 國防部於9月13日上午公布最新共機艦動態統計，自9月12日上午6時起至13日上午6時止，在台海周邊空域與海域共偵獲5架次共機、5艘次共艦以及2艘次公務船，持續在台海周邊區域活動。
根據國防部說明，在偵獲的5架次共機當中，共有3架次共機侵擾西南及東部空域。國軍對此運用任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統，實施嚴密監控與應處。
另據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於9月8日記錄的動態為共機4架次、共艦8艘及公務船4艘；近7日平均為每日共機6.3架次、共艦10.3艘。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 5 PLA Aircraft and 5 Navy Vessels Around Island
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry detected 5 PLA aircraft and 5 naval vessels around the island within 24 hours.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on September 13 that it detected 5 Chinese military aircraft, 5 naval vessels, and 2 public service vessels operating around Taiwan between 6:00 a.m. on September 12 and 6:00 a.m. on September 13.

According to the ministry, 3 of the detected military aircraft entered Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed mission aircraft, naval ships, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activity.
According to SKYTICAL database records, the previous entry on September 8 tracked 4 military aircraft, 8 naval vessels, and 4 public service vessels.
